title: Normal Skin
description: Well-balanced sebum and moisture with smooth texture and minimal blemishes.

title: Oily Skin
description: Overactive sebum production resulting in midday shine, visible pores, and congestion.

title: Dry Skin
description: Lacks natural lipids, causing tightness, flaking, and rough texture.

title: Combination Skin
description: Oily T-zone (forehead, nose, chin) with normal-to-dry cheeks.

title: Sensitive Skin
description: Easily irritated with frequent flushing, stinging reactivity, or redness.
